Commercial & Industrial

Epoxy Floors Built for Business

Commercial floors take punishment that residential floors never see: forklift traffic, chemical spills, constant foot traffic, and heavy cleaning chemicals. A floor coating system designed for a home garage simply won't survive in a commercial environment — and a failed commercial floor isn't just ugly, it creates safety hazards and potentially impacts your compliance status.

We install commercial and industrial epoxy systems rated for the specific demands of your facility. That means the right thickness, the right hardener chemistry, the right slip coefficient for your environment, and the right surface texture for your type of traffic. We also build in appropriate aisle markings, safety color coding, and containment zones when requested.

We know that business owners can't simply shut down for days at a time for a floor install. We schedule around your operation — nights, weekends, or section-by-section installation to keep your facility running throughout the project.

Commercial Sectors We Serve

Warehouses & Distribution

High-build epoxy or urethane mortar systems rated for heavy forklift traffic and pallet jack use. Aisle marking and safety zones available.

Auto Shops & Dealerships

Chemical-resistant systems that stand up to oils, solvents, brake fluid, and battery acid. Anti-slip aggregate included for safety.

Restaurants & Commercial Kitchens

Seamless, NSF-compliant coatings rated for grease, hot water, and cleaning chemicals. No grout lines to harbor bacteria.

Retail & Showrooms

High-gloss metallic and decorative systems that turn an ordinary retail floor into a design statement that impresses customers.

Medical & Laboratory

Chemical-resistant, seamless coatings meeting cleanroom and clinical environment standards. Easy to sanitize and maintain.

Manufacturing & Light Industrial

Heavy-duty systems with impact resistance and custom color coding for OSHA-compliant safety zone delineation.
